dialogues.speaker: Melies
dialogues.text: If I can get the lighting effects just right on the key mechanisms, then we should be able to get the perfect shot. But we really need to splurge more on props in the future.

choices.text: Splitting your attention between work and inspiration?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Haha, my apologies, force of habit... I believe everyone in my profession must suffer from the same affliction.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: See, I'm here working for you on the side to earn money for shooting my next film. How about... you give me a raise?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: When production's over, I'll give you top billing in the "With Special Thanks To" section of the credits!

choices.text: You sure your own hard-earned Mora will be enough?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: I never have enough funds. Balancing the budget is part of a director's responsibilities.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Considering the overall requirements of the upcoming picture, I'm inclined to... reduce the outlay on so-called star actors and reallocate those funds to props, set design, and special effects.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: After all, there's more to a picture than staring at the actors' faces... Exquisite scenery and richly textured props are key elements, too.

choices.text: I can see you have a lot to consider, but don't forget your work either.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: A skilled director is a master of holding multiple trains of thought. Your attraction's in safe hands, I guarantee!
